title: Ryan's first driving lesson
setting: Supermarket car park, Sunday morning — Ryan is seventeen
settingFa: پارکینگ سوپرمارکت، صبح یکشنبه — رایان هفده ساله است

n1.speaker: tom
n1.text: Right, you're in the back seat as moral support. Ryan's got his provisional licence — tell him to check his mirrors.

translations.fa: خب، تو صندلی عقب برای حمایت روحی هستی. رایان گواهی‌نامهٔ موقت گرفته — بهش بگو آینه‌هاش را چک کنه.

branches.suggestion: Ryan, check your mirrors and signal before you pull out.
branches.suggestionFa: رایان، قبل از حرکت آینه‌ها را چک کن و راهنما بزن.

cultureNote.en: Learners in the UK need a provisional licence and "L" plates, and must drive with a qualified supervisor.

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Easy… easy on the clutch! He's stalled it again. Say something encouraging, would you?

translations.fa: آروم… کلاچ را آروم! دوباره خاموشش کرد. یه چیز دلگرم‌کننده بگو، باشه؟

branches.suggestion: Don't worry, Ryan — everyone stalls at first. Try again.
branches.suggestionFa: نگران نباش رایان — همه اولش ماشین را خاموش می‌کنن. دوباره امتحان کن.

branches.suggestion: You're doing great. Just bring the clutch up slowly.
branches.suggestionFa: خوب داری پیش میری. فقط کلاچ را آروم ول کن.

cultureNote.en: Most UK learners drive manual ("stick shift") cars, so stalling is part of learning.

n3.speaker: tom
n3.text: There he goes! Now, round the car park. Ryan wants to know — did you drive in your country?

translations.fa: راه افتاد! حالا، دور پارکینگ. رایان می‌خواد بدونه — تو کشورت رانندگی می‌کردی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, but on the right-hand side of the road!

cultureNote.en: The UK drives on the left — one of only a few countries in Europe to do so.

n4.speaker: tom
n4.text: Ha, the wrong side! Right, Ryan, there's a roundabout coming. Who has priority?

translations.fa: ها، سمت اشتباه! خب، رایان، یه میدون داره میاد. حق تقدم با کیه؟

branches.suggestion: Give way to traffic coming from the right.
branches.suggestionFa: به ترافیکی که از راست میاد راه بده.

branches.suggestion: Traffic already on the roundabout, from the right.
branches.suggestionFa: ترافیکی که تو میدونه، از سمت راست.

n5.speaker: tom
n5.text: Spot on. He did it! Indicate left to come off. Lovely. Next up — parking.

translations.fa: دقیقاً. انجامش داد! برای خروج راهنمای چپ بزن. عالی. بعدی — پارک کردن.

branches.suggestion: Take it slowly, there's no rush.

n6.speaker: tom
n6.text: He's… in two spaces. Close enough for a first go! What do you think?

translations.fa: اون… تو دو تا جا پارک کرده. برای بار اول کافیه! نظرت چیه؟

branches.suggestion: Not bad at all for a first lesson!
branches.suggestionFa: برای جلسهٔ اول اصلاً بد نیست!

branches.suggestion: At least he didn't hit the trolleys.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Ha! True. He's asking when he can take his test.

translations.fa: ها! درسته. داره می‌پرسه کی می‌تونه امتحان بده.

branches.suggestion: After plenty more lessons, I'd say.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از کلی جلسهٔ دیگه، به نظرم.

branches.suggestion: He needs to pass the theory test first.
branches.suggestionFa: اول باید امتحان تئوری را قبول بشه.

cultureNote.en: The UK driving test has two parts: a theory test (with hazard perception) and a practical test.
cultureNote.fa: امتحان دو بخش دارد: تئوری و عملی.

n8.speaker: tom
n8.text: Exactly. Right, swap seats. I'm driving home — my nerves can't take any more.

translations.fa: دقیقاً. خب، جا عوض کنیم. من می‌رونم خونه — اعصابم دیگه نمی‌کشه.

branches.suggestion: Ha! You did great too, Tom.
branches.suggestionFa: ها! تو هم خوب بودی تام.

branches.suggestion: Well done, Ryan. Same time next week?
branches.suggestionFa: آفرین رایان. هفتهٔ بعد همین موقع؟

n9.speaker: tom
n9.text: Look at him — my boy, driving. Where did the time go, eh?

translations.fa: نگاش کن — پسرم، داره رانندگی می‌کنه. زمان کجا رفت، ها؟
